question_answered: node-level correctness of GroupQueryAttention at Nq/Nkv != 1
question_not_answered: end-to-end behaviour of a full grouped model (no Llama-3 export was run; an 8 GB discrete GPU on this box will not hold one)

hypotheses.H_DISJOINT_HOLDS: arena aliasing argument is invariant in group size
hypotheses.H_DISJOINT_FAILS: grouped arena corrupts the t < past_len region of present
hypotheses.H_DUP_BENIGN: the G duplicate present writers write identical bits
hypotheses.H_DUP_RACES: the G duplicate present writers race; cross-run unstable
